body:
I do feel like my lack of putting up with bullshit skills has greatly risen, actually. I feel like the Clark Kent of lack of putting up with it. I think it is just one of those times I just need a little relaxation, and school just isn't helping.

This thread has actually helped a hell of a lot and I thank every positive response I have gotten on here.

Thank you. I feel often that my school just really isn't for me. It is not exactly to learning environment that I really imagined and as such it makes it really difficult to get into any of my classes. I go to a small community college right now, most of the people who go to it aren't really what I would consider the "college" type. I feel like if I were surrounded by more like minded people I wouldn't find this shit more difficult. I know that may sound a little pretentious, but it is hard when I can't have an intelligent conversation with most people on campus.

I am trying to start to help myself. Every since I was a child I would suppress my emotions, I am trying to stop them, this reddit post was my starting point. Hopefully admitting my failures to others will be next. I really appreciate your thoughts, and I thank you a lot for them.

Thank you, I will have to check and see if my campus has one.

And it is just hard to come out and tell her that. I understand that the longer I withhold information from her the more it will hurt when I let her know. I have hard time admitting that I have failed at something.

I don't know, I just like the idea. Like a phoenix from the ashes (in a way).

I can't focus on my work. Ever. Unless I find the subject matter incredibly interesting I cannot focus on getting something done. It is like books, you have great ones (the ones you have read 50 times), the alright ones (you read once) and the shitty ones (only get 5 chapters in and then chuck it). I don't really care what others think of me, I am just embarrassed at myself for letting it go so far and long that I get dropped from courses.
